content.name: Liam Kowalczyk
content.title: Clinical Nurse, Emergency Department
content.summary: Emergency nurse with nine years' experience across a regional ED and a major Brisbane trauma service, holding AHPRA general registration and a Graduate Certificate in Emergency Nursing. Credentialled triage nurse who helped bring the department's 'seen on time' rate for Category 2 patients from 71% to 86%.

experience.title: Graduate Registered Nurse
bullets: Rotated through medical, surgical and emergency wards in a 12-month graduate transition program, carrying a 4–5 patient load by month three.
Completed 6 clinical competencies including IV cannulation and venepuncture ahead of the program schedule.
Developed a bedside handover checklist for the surgical ward that halved missed post-op observations in a three-week audit.

experience.title: Registered Nurse, Emergency Department
bullets: Worked in a 32-bed regional ED seeing around 140 presentations a day, rotating through resus, acute, short-stay and fast-track.
Earned triage credentialling in 2019 after completing the Emergency Triage Education Kit and 60 supervised triage shifts.
Ran simulated paediatric resuscitation drills for 30 staff each quarter in partnership with the clinical facilitator.
Supported the rollout of nurse-initiated analgesia, cutting the median time to first analgesia from 52 to 31 minutes.

experience.title: Clinical Nurse, Emergency Department
bullets: Lead shifts as team leader in a level 6 trauma ED, coordinating 14 nurses and allocating patients across 58 treatment spaces.
Co-designed a rapid assessment zone at triage that lifted Category 2 'seen on time' performance from 71% to 86% within eight months.
Mentor 8 transition-to-practice nurses each year and assess their emergency competency packages.
Audited sepsis pathway compliance monthly and presented results to the ED quality committee, raising antibiotics-within-60-minutes from 64% to 83%.

achievements.title: AHPRA general registration
achievements.detail: Registered Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia since 2017.

achievements.title: ED Staff Excellence Award, 2023
achievements.detail: Recognised for leadership during a 22-patient mass-casualty response after a highway crash.
